children: Gold edges higher in early Asian trade in a likely technical rebound after tumbling overnight. The hotter-than-expected U.S. October inflation report has raised expectations of a rate hike by the Federal Reserve, say ANZ Research analysts in a note. Gold prices were weighed down overnight as both the U.S. dollar and Treasury yields rose. The analysts also note Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan's comment that she still sees the need for two 25-basis-point hikes, although the Fed may need to move more quickly. Spot gold is 0.2% higher at $4,040.89 an ounce. (sherry.qin@wsj.com)
